<!-- pr-reviewer: acb1149774703fd370d8ab36be0cfb329bd8ffef -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #563; high-tier review of the layer 7430effa..acb11497 only).

**What looks good**
- Loop-cap refusal now names its cause (step, centre-line length, `MAX_LOOPS`); the partial case keeps the engagement refusal and appends the cap. `(None, None)` is a named arm, so no `inf deg` message and no panic path.
- `helix_turns(..).unwrap_or(1.0)` is gone: `emit_level` returns `Result` and refuses past 1024 turns with drop, helix radius and fix (trochoid_slot.rs, emit_level). Both callers propagate with `?`.
- Microlift bound is one rule, `OpParams::microlift_refusal` (types/sane.rs:1127), asked with resolved heights by `microlift_sane` from `heights_gate` (gates.rs:166). `heights_gate` is reached from create (create.rs:98, 170), edit (edit.rs:117, 201), source change (edit.rs:285) and geometry change (geometry.rs:57). Undo/redo only replays previously gated values; MCP and UI go through the same `CreateOperation` / `EditOperationParams`, so no side door. `TrochoidParams::validate` repeats the law as a backstop, which also covers a later setup-height change or a loaded project.
- No golden or snapshot change in this layer (`trochoid_slot_small` golden untouched and passing). No build.rs, .github, scripts or dependency changes. `trochoid_slot.rs` 397 lines, `trochoid_loops.rs` 336; the moved `contained` / `arc_samples` are byte-identical.
- Decision file present (`docs/decisions/774-trochoid-refusals.md`) with the chosen bound and the alternatives dropped. Body has `Changelog:`, `Effort: high (not escalated)` and `Fixes #774`; no CHANGELOG.md edit.

**Local results** (PR head, trial merge with upstream/main was already up to date; Linux-equivalent run on macOS)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test trochoid_slot` | 10 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib trochoid` | 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test trochoid_op` | 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl trochoid` | 1 passed (golden unchanged) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib operation::` | 71 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Pin check: I neutralised the `TrochoidParams::validate` microlift guard locally; `trochoid_microlift_above_the_clearance_plane_is_refused` then failed with `expected the microlift refusal, got Ok(Toolpath ...)`. Guard restored, tree clean.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `microlift_sane` returns `None` when heights do not resolve (`r.top?`, heights_sel.rs:195). Fine because an unresolved height is refused elsewhere by name, but a one-line test would pin that no lift slips through then.
2. `sane.rs` is already 1138 lines (+19 here); flag for a later split.
3. Process: this layer's `7430effa` base is #563, so merge #563 first; I did not re-review it here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
